emma_cs: Heads-up team — PaperTrail onboarding stress test today revealed p95 spikes during burst imports. Trial customer, renewal due in 10 days.
devin_eng: numbers? model? config?
emma_cs: p50=95ms p95=1.4s p99=2.1s. Model: redwood/chat-7b-std (fp16). Avg batch=6, tokens/request ~ 520. Route: hosted-us-east standard.
li_research: my read: long-context GC + KV cache churn. Options: 1) try int8 quantized variant of 7b for prefix-heavy flows 2) model-hop to rlhf-13b-small (lower decoding steps w/ distill) for accuracy-critical endpoints 3) split routes by endpoint type (import vs interactive).
devin_eng: prefer incremental changes. Proposal: 10% traffic to quantized 7b with immediate fallback to fp16 on QoS regressions; also create an import-specific low-batch route (max_batch=2, SLO-focused).
noah_support: PaperTrail wants a short note on accuracy tradeoffs for quantization and the rollback process before we flip canary. They specifically asked about rare tokenization edge cases.
li_research: draft blurb: "Quantized (int8) models typically reduce latency 25-40% for this workload with negligible change in semantic accuracy on our eval (median delta 0.8%). Rare tokenization edge cases can cause slight output variance; we'll monitor targeted evals and have automatic rollback if semantic regression >3%."
devin_eng: instrumentation checklist to add to the enablement call: 1) enable token-latency histogram 2) push canary logs to test workspace 3) add eval job comparing sample set every 30m 4) pager trigger if p95 > 1s for 10m.
deploy-bot: canary created: papertrail-quant-canary-3971111111. CI: ✅ infra-check: ✅. Scheduled apply: 15:05 EDT.
emma_cs: I'll share the blurb + checklist with PaperTrail and schedule a 15:20 EDT sync. If we see >2% semantic drift or any customer complaint, we'll rollback to hosted-fp16 within 15 minutes. :white_check_mark:
